lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Classify: $8 weekly train ticket (same every week), $3–$7 school canteen purchases, $5 library late fine that happens rarely.

FEEDBACK
Train ticket is fixed for that week’s travel pattern. Canteen is variable. A rare fine is irregular/variable, not a weekly fixed line.

WATCH FOR
Treating every expense as fixed because it appeared once on a receipt. One receipt does not prove the same amount every week.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
List two fixed and two variable expenses a Year 7 student might have. Explain in one sentence how you decided each label. Do not copy Sam’s music fee.

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.
